# T-3: Surface review recovery state

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose review stop reasons and recovery operations through next-action and status so users and agents can recover without parsing raw error text.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 next-action includes structured stop reason and recovery command for review stops.
- R6 status summarizes the active review stop reason and next recovery operation.
- Existing next-action and status fields remain available.
- next-action/status read provider/input stop reasons from flow.json reviewStop.
- status exposes reviewStop as a structured summary field and may also include a human-readable summary.

## Implementation Notes
Use the same recovery metadata as run-review. Avoid duplicating command string construction in multiple modules.

## Test Strategy
CLI/unit tests that seed flow metrics or failure state and assert next-action/status recovery fields.
